description: Twenty-five rings, a giant carousel, bumper brawls and banana-dropping balloons. Gold in five minutes.
Fifteen treasure chests in a two-story dungeon maze. Lava pits, jail cells and giant snapping traps. Gold in two and a half minutes.
Race across colored tiles above a lava lake, dodge snapping dinosaurs, and jump the slime pit before climbing to the checkered finish.
Drop down a striped tower ramp, pass a red wyvern on the stacked causeway, and jump the slime before the raptor finish.
Race beneath five balloons, thread the yellow jaws and blue tile, then time the lime dinosaur's snap before the checkered transporter.
Dodge rising screws, jump a timed eruption, pick the safe gate and outrun the drill tank and crusher claw before the slime detour.
Ride a guided amber pipe onto the purple causeway, duck under twin silver overpasses, and jump the slime before the checkered finish.
Start atop the fireplace, race a tabletop obstacle course, ride the chair bridge onto the piano keys, and finish through the giant ring.
Race the Halloween toy track: yellow straight, junction bend, blue slide, slime jump, orange loop turn, east bend and south straight to the finish ring.
Race under the red arch, jump the slime, hit the booster to clear the 40-unit gap, then thread the dino junction to the standing red brick.
Dodge a double-size chomp book, thread the screw field, shun the EVIL tube trap past the bumps, ride the transit tube across the lava, and jump the crater before the checkered finish.
Thread walled gates, jump the crater, ride the auto-steer tube, time the spinning window, dodge the chomp book and jump to the red finish over melting slime.
Loop the arena for 18 rings: dodge the carousel and bumper brawl, time the chomp book and two glazed donut jaws, and outrun three ghosts.
Race the black road under the blue gate, dodge two dinos, thread tile chicanes, detour into the bumper arena, race the south chicanes, and smash three letter-block barricades.
Run the snowy U past a chomp book, smash letter blocks and burning coals, dodge a giant raptor and burst a triple snowman before the checkered finish.
Circle the loop past the chomp book, hands and squish cup, then boost the lava gap beside the erupting volcano to the finish.
Escape the double bumper arena, time three bag-clip snaps, dodge the scrap bot, ride the flagpole over the top and smash the glass tower to the finish.
Staircase sprint on the wide pink road: thread candy-cane arches, smash candy apples and peppermint barrels, and time two snap jaws. Gold in fifty seconds.
Sweep the mint loop past lollipop dividers, smash chocolate crates and the cotton-candy cart, and time the gummy vice, shears and sugar chomper.
Night serpentine on red peppermint: brave the jawbreaker crusher, peppermint slammer, snap jaws and caramel crusher between gumdrop boulder fields.
Zigzag the narrow chocolate road, slalom two chocolate-bar chicanes, and survive five snap traps from chomper to jawbreaker crusher.
The midnight finale: a narrow glowing-violet serpentine with six press and snap traps and eight candy wrecks between you and the gold finish.
Rolling hill sprint on the wide snow road: thread light arches over two climbs, smash ornaments and cracker barrels, and time the toy chomper and tinsel snapper. Gold in fifty seconds.
Diagonal dash to the mountain tube: brave the nutcracker and ice vice, climb to the guided pipe, and dodge the ornament slammer past fragile ice fields.
Night mountain climb with a summit plateau, a valley jump and four snap traps from yeti jaws to the sleigh crusher above frozen lakes.
Valley zigzag with rolling hills and a fire-road jump: survive five snap traps from nutcracker to tinsel snapper between walls of fragile ice.
The midnight finale: a diagonal ascent with hills and a jump, a mountain tube ride, and six press and snap traps across the frozen summit.
Scrap across the toy table for eight scattered rings: two stunt loops, a dino launcher, cacti desert, potion tube, snapping jaws and two ghosts.
Smash the block wall, jump the cacti, skim the shark pool at full speed, then drive the dino mouth tunnel to the gray platform finish.
